basic_info.name: MusicFM (A Foundation Model for Music Informatics). Variants by pre-training set: MusicFM-FMA (released), MusicFM-MSD (open checkpoint), and larger in-house 160K h runs (paper-only).
basic_info.org: Minz Won (Suno, formerly ByteDance), Yun-Ning Hung (ByteDance), Manh Duc Le (ByteDance). ICASSP 2024.
basic_info.release_date: arXiv 2311.03318 posted 2023-11-06; ICASSP 2024 (March 2024); repo/checkpoints on HF minzwon/MusicFM since late 2023 (checkpoint fixed 2024-02-13).

architecture.backbone: Conformer encoder (12-layer, ~330M params; ablations also covered BERT-encoder and other sizes) over Mel spectrograms at 25 Hz frame rate; BEST-RQ-derived tokenization target (random-projection quantizer, 8 codebooks x 1024).
architecture.input_modality: audio only (24 kHz mono). No text tower.
architecture.training_objective: Masked language modeling predicting BEST-RQ-style randomly-projected quantized tokens (online target extraction, no tokenizer pre-training, no auxiliary CQT loss); masked prediction with cross-entropy, 30 s clips.
architecture.embedding_output: Frame-level hidden states, 1024-d at 25 Hz from 12 Conformer layers; no native global embedding — downstream users pool over time (e.g., mean over frames/layers). No joint text embedding.

data.training_data: Released FMA checkpoint: FMA-large, ~8K h Creative Commons audio (chosen to avoid licensing complications). Open MSD checkpoint: Million Song Dataset audio. Paper's strongest internal run: ~160K h in-house (not released). License of the internal set not disclosed.

performance.benchmarks: SSL-family (MARBLE suite): MusicFM (MSD checkpoint) avg 75.4 vs MERT 74.4 and MuQ 77.0; strong MTT tagging ROC-AUC 91.3 and frame-level tasks, weak key detection (63.9 refined). Original paper showed Conformer > BERT encoder and random tokenization generalizing well to music. Not evaluated on MuChoMusic/MusicBench/Song Describer (LLM-family suites).
performance.vs_clap: No direct CLAP comparison in the paper (no text tower). As MuLan-style contrastive backbone (MusicFM-MuLan, paper-reported): MTT zero-shot tagging ROC-AUC 76.2 / PR-AUC 27.1 vs LAION-CLAP 73.9 / 25.0 — slightly above CLAP, below MuQ-MuLan 79.3 despite identical architecture and contrastive setup, showing MusicFM SSL init is weaker than MuQ's.

availability.license: Code MIT (flash_conformer Apache-2.0, dual-licensed); checkpoint weights are downloadable from HF but the weights carry no explicit standalone license — effectively research-use only given FMA CC audio and unstated terms of the MSD-trained weights [uncertain for weight licensing]. Requires torch (Conformer), not pure numpy.

fit_for_local_playlist.sample_rate: 24 kHz (MusicFM25Hz class, 25 Hz feature rate); repo standard 48 kHz needs resampling.
fit_for_local_playlist.inference_cost: ~330M params; fp32 checkpoint ~1.3 GB. GPU-recommended, CPU feasible but slow for library-scale indexing [uncertain for exact latency].
fit_for_local_playlist.full_track_context: 30 s clips in training; no native long context — windowed inference + pooling for full tracks.
fit_for_local_playlist.frame_level_support: Yes — 25 Hz frame-level hidden states for section-level logic.
fit_for_local_playlist.retrieval_steering: None — plain feature extractor; no text alignment or attribute control.

uncertain: License terms of the MusicFM checkpoint weights (code MIT, weights have no explicit license statement)
